about: STEP-07 §4's first draft — what the drafter proposes from the design partner's memory patterns alone — written in the golden world's names, and accepted by the golden founder as it stands. Every case runs with it: `tests/replays/engine_runner._fresh_tenant` seeds each line as the founder's own (`platform/company_brief_store.add`), in this order, before the case's first sweep. Real names never appear: StartupSetu is the recognition portal, DigiVault the document locker, Introly the intro agent, Lakshya the program the founder is in, Gulf Launchpad the accelerator applied to.
